title: A sharp bound on the integrality gap in the 3-set cover problem
summary: Given a hypergraph with edges of size at most 3, the 3-set cover problem asks to determine the minimum size of a family of edges which covers the vertex set. As the problem is NP-hard, it is natural to consider its fractional (linear programming) relaxation, which provides a lower bound on the value of the optimal solution. The ratio between the actual value and that of the fractional relaxation is called the integrality gap. A classic bound of Lovász implies that the integrality gap in this problem is at most 11/6.
